title: 364. Single Number III

examples.explanation: 1 and 2 each appear twice, leaving 3 and 5. Returning [5,3] is also accepted.
Both values appear once, so both are returned.

hints: Xor all values to get the xor of the two answers, then isolate any set bit where they differ.
Split the array by that bit and xor each group separately to recover the two values.
